name: Prototype/Live UI Convergence

implemented_behavior: Strict separation between live production workspaces (/operations and /operations/dispatch-jobs/{id}) and unrouted prototype demo surfaces (pages/operations.tsx).
Elimination of fake local writes that mimic backend actions in prototype state reducers, replacing them with clear simulation notifications (e.g. [Read-Only Simulation]).

Implementation of high-visibility [Prototype / Sandbox Demo Mode - Read-Only Simulation] banners and badges across all prototype pages, frames, and surface components (GuidedDispatch, DispatchBoard, LiveOperations, AdministratorOverview, AdministrationSurface, ManagerOverview, ReportsSurface, FieldMobileApp, ResourceDirectory, FuelManagement, LocalOperationsMap).

Relocation of live TrackingSurface from components/surfaces/ to components/workspace/tracking-workspace-section.tsx, establishing complete isolation of live workspace sections from prototype surfaces.
Creation of a formal dev-only fixtures boundary in resources/js/data/fixtures/ with README.md and index.ts enforcing that live production routes never import mock fixture datasets.

Unification and enforcement of canonical status vocabularies across all types and surfaces: DispatchStatusValue (draft, pending_approval, scheduled, dispatched, accepted, en_route, arrived, working, completed, cancelled), DispatchPriorityValue (routine, priority, emergency), AssetStatusValue (available, assigned, in_transit, on_site, maintenance, out_of_service, working, under_inspection, under_maintenance, awaiting_parts, ready_for_service, unavailable), ApprovalStatusValue (pending, approved, rejected), and Location Freshness (fresh, delayed, stale, offline).
Updated CanonicalStatusBadge and StatusBadge with complete tone classes and icons for all canonical and prototype status combinations.
